description: sort_index() is not stable, so which duplicate row survives drop_duplicates is arbitrary: with 286 duplicated minutes about half kept the later absurd row, in shuffled and in original-first files. The Nifty loader sorts with mergesort. The Bitstamp loader also does not report the number of duplicates.
recommended_action: Use sort_index(kind='mergesort') and count duplicates in df.attrs

description: Zero close gives +-inf returns and negative close gives NaN returns with only a RuntimeWarning; load_binance masks non-positive prices and reports the count, the other two do not.
recommended_action: Mask non-positive prices as load_binance does and report the count

description: No validation of cal_len (0 and 1 accepted, 12 alarms in 3000 null steps instead of about 0.4; 10 gives 8), threshold (0, negative, 1 and NaN accepted), c (NaN accepted: never calibrates), null_band >= 1 (decrease side silently off). c <= 0 and cal_len < 0 are caught only by messages about other parameters (c_down, cal_max).
recommended_action: Validate: cal_len >= 20 (warn below 100), threshold > 1, c finite and > 0 (warn below 1.5), null_band < 1; name the right parameter

description: Non-numeric input (string, None, 2-D array) is accepted into the calibration buffer and fails with TypeError or ValueError only when calibration ends
recommended_action: Coerce with float(r) and raise at once

description: All-NaN or constant-price streams leave the monitor blind forever with no warning; only cal_stats['restarted'] shows it
recommended_action: Warn or expose a status when calibration restarts repeatedly

description: The false-alarm guarantee fails under GARCH clustering and unremoved intraday seasonality for every variant, including the README setting: GARCH(0.05,0.90) 7.3 percent within a day, GARCH(0.08,0.90) 46.9 percent (known baseline 37.9 and 86.9 percent), seasonality 54 percent for the known baseline; the band and the confidence sequence rescue only the seasonality case. This is the documented E10 limit, now measured with fresh seeds.
recommended_action: State the limit next to the 5 percent claim; recommend forecast-relative mode for clustered data

description: Outliers inside the calibration window inflate the baseline: with 25 outliers of 15 sd in 500 steps (README setting) 68.7 percent of runs false-alarm within 2500 steps; 10 outliers 0.7 percent. The robust MAD protects the scale but the clipped outliers still enter the mean.
recommended_action: Document; consider trimming extreme values from the calibration mean or a contamination check

description: Approximately valid only: within a day at most 3.1 percent, but within five days 26.7 to 28.0 percent on five independent laws against the nominal 25 percent (lower interval bounds 25.1 to 26.4 percent).
recommended_action: Keep the README label 'approximate'; recommend band or cs baseline for any claim over more than one day

description: Very conservative: 0.0 percent false alarms within a day on every iid law, but a variance doubling takes a median 112 steps (Gaussian LR 43, tuned z-test 39, Page 33); a 1.5x increase 506 steps; a fall to 2/3 of the variance is detected in only 77 percent of runs within five days (median 883). Band 0.1 gives 71 and 152 steps with 1.2 percent false alarms over five days.
recommended_action: Say so next to the false-alarm claim; consider band 0.1 or the cs baseline as the headline setting

description: Power cliff at c <= 1 (or MAD scaling 0.5): only 7 percent of variance doublings and 47 percent of halvings detected; no truncation (c = 1e6) detects 0 percent of decreases; c = 10 detects 84 percent of decreases with median delay 1698.

No violation of any proved bound under Gaussian, t3, t5, jump contamination or infinite-variance Pareto(1.5) with 3000 paths per law: known baseline at most 1.7 percent within a day and 14.7 percent within five days (bounds 5 and 25 percent); cs monitor and README setting at most 0.03 percent within a day.

Three files match data/MANIFEST.csv hashes and row counts; no duplicates, gaps, non-positive prices, inconsistent OHLC, flat or zero-volume bars; 36 returns beyond 20 robust sd are genuine heavy tails. Covers 3 of 140 manifest files; others not downloaded.
recommended_action: Download and check the remaining files when time allows
